name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko Babić brings a wealth of human resources experience to JOTA Sport, having spent over two decades in various HR roles across different industries before finding his passion in motorsport. Born and raised in Zagreb, Marko's career initially focused on manufacturing, but a lifelong fascination with racing led him to pursue opportunities within the motorsport world. He's known for his meticulous approach to talent acquisition and development, firmly believing that a strong, cohesive team is the key to success on and off the track.

At JOTA Sport, Marko is responsible for overseeing all aspects of HR, from recruitment and training to performance management and employee relations. He is dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive work environment where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. Marko is particularly focused on identifying and nurturing young talent, ensuring the team has a pipeline of skilled individuals ready to take on future challenges. His ambition is to make JOTA Sport the most sought-after team to work for in endurance racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Marko is of average height with a sturdy build and a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always has a small Croatian flag on his desk.
Insists on starting every team meeting with a brief motivational quote.
Keeps a meticulously organized spreadsheet of every employee's birthday and work anniversary.
